sentences.en: We should strike a balance between our expenditure and income.
sentences.zh: 我们应该在开支和收入之间找到平衡。

sentences.en: My income falls short of my expenditure by five hundred pounds.
sentences.zh: 我的收入比支出少了五百英镑。

sentences.en: You'll have to proportion your expenditure to your income.
sentences.zh: 你必须根据你的收入来调整开支。

senses.zh: 花费，支出,费用，经费,（尤指金钱的）支出额,（精力、时间、材料等的）耗费
